name: Absolute 375SC Systemic Fungicide
ai: Azoxystrobin 200 g/L + Difenoconazole 125 g/L + Hexaconazole 50 g/L
uses: fungal diseases on vegetables and fruit trees
targets: Fungal diseases on vegetables, fruit trees, cereals and ornamentals (preventive and curative)
settings: Commercial farms, small farms, kitchen gardens and trial plots
lead: Absolute 375SC is a systemic fungicide that protects crops before infection and treats diseases already on the plant. Three active ingredients in one product give broad control of fungal diseases on vegetables, fruit trees, cereals and ornamentals, on commercial farms and in kitchen gardens alike.
method: Mix and spray with a knapsack sprayer, early morning or late afternoon, in calm weather. Do not spray if rain is expected soon.
extraSteps: Start the spray programme early, before disease is widespread, and keep scouting the crop.
If spots, mildew or rust are already visible, spray promptly: curative action works best on early infections.

name: Agrixyl 407 Fungicide
targets: Fungal infections in crops (broad-spectrum disease control)
lead: Agrixyl 407 is a high-performance fungicide for broad-spectrum control of fungal infections in crops. It suits large-scale farming and helps protect yield and plant health.
method: Mix and apply exactly as the manufacturer's label directs. Never mix with other products unless the label allows it.

name: Beanpro 480SL Herbicide
uses: broadleaf weeds and grasses in beans
targets: Broadleaf weeds and grasses in bean fields
lead: Beanpro 480SL is a selective herbicide that controls broadleaf weeds and grasses in bean fields. Applied early post-emergence, while weeds are still young, it gives beans a clean start and cuts competition for light, water and nutrients.
method: Spray with a calibrated knapsack sprayer so the whole field gets the same, correct amount. Spray in calm weather, early morning or late afternoon.
extraSteps: Spray early post-emergence, while weeds are young; do not spray a crop stressed by drought, waterlogging or disease.

name: Bradley 500SC Fungicide
uses: powdery mildew, rust and anthracnose on French beans
targets: Powdery mildew, rust, anthracnose and Cercospora leaf spot
settings: Agricultural: French beans and other crops
lead: Bradley 500SC controls powdery mildew, rust, anthracnose and Cercospora leaf spot on French beans and other crops. Its bitertanol suspension concentrate protects export- and market-grade pods from the diseases that spoil them.
method: Shake the container well, half-fill the tank with water, add the measured product, top up and keep agitating while you spray. Cover leaves and pods evenly and avoid the heat of the day.
extraSteps: Start a protective programme early and rotate with fungicides from other chemical groups; do not exceed the label's number of applications.

name: Catapult 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide
uses: annual and perennial weeds before planting
settings: Agricultural: land clearing before planting maize, French beans and other crops; minimum or zero tillage
lead: Catapult 480SL is a non-selective glyphosate herbicide that clears annual and perennial weeds before you plant maize, French beans and other crops. It suits minimum and zero-tillage burndown, saving soil, moisture, time and fuel.
method: Use a clean sprayer with a suitable nozzle and shield where possible. Spray actively growing weeds in calm, dry weather and avoid drift onto crops or neighbouring plots.
extraSteps: Do not spray weeds covered in dust or under drought stress, or when rain is expected soon.
Plant into the cleared field only after the waiting period on the label.

name: Commander 240EC Herbicide
uses: grasses, broadleaf weeds and sedges in onions
targets: Grasses, broadleaf weeds and sedges in onions
settings: Agricultural: onion fields (pre-emergence and early post-emergence)
lead: Commander 240EC is an oxyfluorfen herbicide for onions. Applied pre-emergence or on very young weeds, it controls grasses, broadleaf weeds and sedges during the weeks when onions compete worst.
method: Prepare a fine, level seedbed, then apply evenly with a clean, calibrated sprayer. Avoid windy conditions and keep spray off crops not listed on the label.
extraSteps: Time the spray to the crop and weed stage shown on the label; on first use, test a small area.

name: Digester Supper 69 EW Herbicide
lead: Digester Supper 69 EW is a post-emergence herbicide that controls annual grass weeds in wheat. Its 5 litre pack suits commercial wheat growers treating larger areas.
method: Use a clean, well-calibrated sprayer and do not overlap passes. Spray in calm weather and keep spray away from maize, barley, sorghum and pasture grasses.
extraSteps: Spray when grass weeds and wheat are at the stages on the label; avoid crops stressed by drought, frost or waterlogging.

name: Jembe Star 500SL Herbicide
uses: broadleaf weeds and grasses in non-cropped areas
settings: Non-cropped areas: paths, road edges, fence lines, compounds, yards and industrial sites. Not for use on or around growing crops
lead: Jembe Star 500SL combines glyphosate and 2,4-D to clear annual broadleaf weeds and grasses from paths, road edges, fence lines, compounds, yards and industrial sites. It is for non-cropped areas only, not for use on or around growing crops.
method: Use a clean sprayer with a suitable nozzle in calm, dry weather. Do not spray in wind or when rain is expected soon.
extraSteps: Take particular care near vegetables, beans, tomatoes, coffee and roses: a very small amount of 2,4-D drift can harm broadleaf plants.
Rinse the sprayer very well afterwards, away from crops and water; use a dedicated sprayer if you can.

name: Maguguma Top 500 SC Herbicide
uses: broadleaf weeds and grasses in maize
targets: Broadleaf weeds and grasses in maize
settings: Agricultural: maize fields (pre-emergence, or early post-emergence on newly germinated weeds)
lead: Maguguma Top 500 SC is a pre-emergence herbicide for maize that stops broadleaf weeds and grasses from germinating. It can also be used early post-emergence on newly germinated weeds, giving maize a clean start and cutting hand-weeding rounds.
method: Shake the container well, half-fill the tank with water, add the measured product, top up and agitate throughout. Spray evenly on a fine, moist, clod-free seedbed.
extraSteps: Keep spray off neighbouring broadleaf crops such as beans and vegetables, and check the label for rotation restrictions before the next crop.

name: Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide
uses: annual and perennial weeds on large areas
targets: Annual and perennial weeds such as couch grass (non-selective)
settings: Agricultural land preparation; non-crop areas around buildings, fences, roads, paths and yards
lead: Weed-Out 480SL is a broad-spectrum glyphosate herbicide for non-selective control of annual and perennial weeds before planting and in non-crop areas. Its 5 litre pack suits farms, estates and contractors clearing large areas.
method: Use clean water, a clean sprayer and a flat-fan nozzle at the label rate. Spray actively growing weeds in calm weather, with a shielded sprayer where possible.
extraSteps: Do not slash or cut weeds straight after spraying: the product needs time to move through the plant.
Avoid spraying just before rain, and keep drift off crops, trees, gardens and neighbouring farms.
